dossiers.label: Thrasymachus: justice is the advantage of the stronger
dossiers.about: Thrasymachus bursts in like a wild beast: justice is nothing but the advantage of the stronger; each ruling power makes laws for its own advantage and calls them just. Socrates draws him into the ruler 'in the precise sense', who like the doctor or the pilot serves those in his care.
